sources.title: Kiwix library
sources.desc: ZIM archives for the Kiwix information library: Wikipedia, medical references, repair guides, travel guides and books.
sources.note: Kiwix publishes new builds every few months and removes old ones. If a download fails with HTTP 404, update the date in config/content.json (see download.kiwix.org/zim/).

items.title: Wikipedia: top 100 articles
items.desc: The 100 most read English Wikipedia articles with images. A small first download to check everything works.

items.title: Simple English Wikipedia (no images)
items.desc: All of Simple English Wikipedia in plain language, without images.

items.title: Wikipedia: mini
items.desc: Every English Wikipedia article, introduction and infobox only, no images.

items.title: Wikipedia: full text (no images)
items.desc: Every English Wikipedia article in full, without images.

items.title: Wikipedia: complete (with images)
items.desc: Every English Wikipedia article in full, with images. Needs a large drive.

items.title: WikiMed (MDWiki) medical encyclopedia
items.desc: Medical articles from MDWiki, the successor to the WikiMed project: diseases, drugs, anatomy and procedures.

items.title: iFixit repair guides
items.desc: Step-by-step repair guides with photos for electronics, appliances, vehicles and tools.

items.title: Energypedia (no images)
items.desc: Practical knowledge on solar, biogas, micro-hydro, cooking stoves and off-grid power.

items.title: Wikivoyage (no images)
items.desc: The English travel guide: places, routes, getting around, local services. Without images.

items.title: Wikivoyage (with images)
items.desc: The English travel guide with maps and images.

items.title: Project Gutenberg: military science (LCC U)
items.desc: Public domain English books in Library of Congress class U: field craft, tactics, engineering and logistics.

sources.title: Kolibri channels
sources.desc: Course channels imported into Kolibri from Kolibri Studio. Deploy and start KOLIBRI first.
sources.note: Sizes are for the whole channel. Imports run inside the Kolibri container; progress is estimated from the growth of its data folder.

items.title: Khan Academy (English, US curriculum)
items.desc: Videos and exercises: maths, science, computing, history and economics.

items.title: Khan Academy (Español)
items.desc: Videos y ejercicios de matemáticas, ciencias y más.

items.title: CK-12
items.desc: Digital textbooks and exercises for maths, science, English and history.

items.title: PhET interactive simulations
items.desc: Hands-on physics, chemistry, biology and maths simulations with lesson plans.

items.title: African Storybook Library
items.desc: Illustrated picture books for early readers in many languages.

items.title: TESSA teacher resources
items.desc: Teacher education resources for literacy, numeracy, science and life skills.

sources.title: Ollama models
sources.desc: Language models for the Advisor, pulled into the Ollama service. Deploy and start OLLAMA first.
sources.note: Sizes are approximate download sizes. A model needs about its size in free memory to run; small models suit small machines.

items.title: Llama 3.2 1B
items.desc: Very small and fast. Runs on a Raspberry Pi 5 or an old laptop.

items.title: Llama 3.2 3B
items.desc: A good default for the Advisor on 8 GB of memory.

items.title: Qwen 2.5 3B
items.desc: Small multilingual model, good at following instructions.

items.title: Gemma 2 2B
items.desc: Small general model from Google.

items.title: Mistral 7B
items.desc: Stronger answers; needs about 8 GB of free memory.

items.title: Llama 3.1 8B
items.desc: Stronger answers; needs about 8 to 10 GB of free memory.

items.title: Nomic Embed Text
items.desc: Embedding model for better manual search in the Advisor.
